about: Words a cook writes that are no unit of data/units.json. `sized`: a word with a size read in a named source (words, unit, factor, source with the quoted sentence); none so far. `noFixedSize`: a word with no size read in any source, kept as written without a number, like "to taste", with the reason. To give a word a size, move it to `sized` with its source; nothing else changes.
